tei:div.tei:p: 67)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: me tshogs gtong ba dngos grub lcags kyu bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

gsang sngags snod dang ldan pa yi: ma 'ongs skal ldan skyes bu yis: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la: brten nas me tshogs 'bul ba'i thabs: spros med rgyun khyer 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: du ba med pa'i me nang du: 'byor tshogs bsreg rdzas kun bsags nas: bdag bskyed bsdus tsam sngon song mthar: swa bhā wa yis me thab sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rdzas byin brlabs: āḥ me thab dmigs med stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: me dkyil drag po'i gzhal yas khang: bkod pa lhun grub rab rdzogs dbus: pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng: dbyings nas sa bon gdan la babs: yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che: gtso dang 'khor gyi rnam pa ru: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i snying po las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: mtsho la kha char babs pa ltar: spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la bstims: dam ye dbyer med ro cig bzhugs: 68)zag med bdud rtsis mnyes mchod 'bul: sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hiḥ lha dang gnyis med ye phyag 'tshal: kun snang ye shes rgyan gyis mchod: khyab brdal chos dbyings ngang du bstod: ljags dkyil dbus su ram̐ yig las: 'od zer byung ba'i khong seng nas: bsreg rdzas ye shes bdud rtsir 'bul: dgyes bzhes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ ma hā sarba pañca pū dza la khā hi: 'di ltar grangs ldan phul mthar 'dod gsol ni: yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdud rtsi sreg blug gi mchod pa phul bas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad ngan pa thams cad mi 'byung zhing tshe 'dir 'pho med phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dam pa thob par mdzod cig: ces skabs su sbyar mthar: pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: lan nyer gcig gis bdud rtsi phul nas:

phyi nang gsang mchod sngags kyis 'bul: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang stong gnyis med rdo rje phur pa'i lha: yab yum sprul 'khor bka' sdod bcas la bstod: mi gnas gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang byin dngos grub 69)stsol: badz+ra kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hūm̐: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: 'gal 'khrul nyams chags ci mchis bshags: bsod nams tshogs gnyis 'gro la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas sa thob shog: oṃ: ye shes lha tshogs dbyings su gshegs: dam tshig pa nyid rang la bsdu: 'bar ba me yis bgegs rnams 'joms: badz+ra muṃ: hrīḥ mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden stobs kyis: bde legs phun tshogs bkra shis shog: de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs nas: dmigs kyi lde kha bsgyur mkhas na: gang 'dod phrin las rnam pa bzhi 'grub: khyad par dbang drag las 'grub nas: mchog gi rig 'dzin nges par thob: phur srung dam can gter bdag dang: gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mor gtad: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: lang gro a tsār sprul pa mchog: pra dz+nya dh+wa dza'i dpal du shog: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang rang slob dam pa bkra shis che ring sogs slob bu rnams kyis nan cher bskul ngor/ dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las bde ba'i rdo rjes dag par phabs pa'o// 70)
